project_type: Monorepo with React Native (Expo Router) mobile app and React (Vite) web app
language: JavaScript/JSX (no TypeScript in source, but tsconfig exists for type-checking)
build_system: Bun workspaces, Expo CLI for mobile, Vite for web
test_framework: Vitest for web (vitest run), TypeScript noEmit for both
build_command: Mobile: npx expo export --platform android | Web: bun run build (in apps/web/)
test_command: Mobile: npx tsc --noEmit (in apps/mobile/) | Web: bun run lint && bun run typecheck (in apps/web/)
verification_instructions: 1. Mobile: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform android (exit 0). 2. Mobile: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit (exit 0). 3. Web: cd apps/web && bun run build (exit 0). 4. Web: cd apps/web && bun run lint (0 errors). 5. Web: cd apps/web && bun run typecheck (exit 0). 6. All 7 locale files per platform must have identical key sets.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No Android emulator available for runtime testing, must rely on static analysis (expo export, tsc).
contribution_requirements: All 7 locale files (en, es, pt, hi, ja, ko, id) on both mobile and web must have identical key sets. Theme colors from theme.js must be used consistently.
key_patterns: Tab navigation via Expo Router Tabs in (tabs)/_layout.jsx. Theme colors/spacing/typography from src/theme.js. Translation keys accessed via useTranslation() hook from src/i18n. API calls use fetchWithCache pattern in utils/api.js. Content cards use ContentCard.jsx with item.rating field available. Genre pills in DetailHero are currently non-interactive Views. Recommendations on detail pages use ContentRail (horizontal scroll).
directory_structure: apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/ - tab screens (home, browse, downloads, profile). apps/mobile/src/app/ - non-tab screens (movie/[id], tv/[id], genre/[id], player). apps/mobile/src/components/ - reusable components. apps/mobile/src/i18n/locales/ - 7 locale JSON files. apps/web/src/components/ - web reusable components. apps/web/src/i18n/locales/ - 7 locale JSON files.
